mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,'RULE' AS asset_type,a.rule_code AS asset_code,a.rule_code AS asset_name,a.check_target_type,a.rule_category,a.system_code,sys.name AS system_name,a.table_name_en,a.table_name_cn,a.field_name_en,a.field_name_cn,a.rule_code_desc,a.rule_description,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_rule a LEFT JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.project_id=a.project_id AND c.system_code=a.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem sys ON sys.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND sys.code=c.system_code AND sys.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND a.deleted=#{p.deleted} AND a.check_target_type=#{p.checkTargetType} AND a.rule_category=#{p.ruleCategory} AND a.system_code=#{p.systemCode} AND (a.rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.ruleKeyword},'%') OR a.rule_code_desc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.ruleKeyword},'%') OR a.rule_description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.ruleKeyword},'%')) AND (a.rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR a.rule_code_desc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%')a.table_name_cn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR a.table_name_en LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR a.field_name_en LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.rule_code ASC,a.id ASCa.rule_code ASC,a.id ASCa.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1

SELECT id,project_id,system_code,check_target_type,rule_category,rule_code,rule_code_desc,rule_description,table_name_en,table_name_cn,field_name_en,field_name_cn,owner_id FROM dm_rule WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_rule SET check_target_type=#{p.checkTargetType},rule_category=#{p.ruleCategory},system_code=#{p.systemCode},rule_code=#{p.ruleCode},rule_code_desc=#{p.ruleCodeDesc},rule_description=#{p.ruleDescription},table_name_en=#{p.tableNameEn},table_name_cn=#{p.tableNameCn},field_name_en=#{p.fieldNameEn},field_name_cn=#{p.fieldNameCn},updated_by=#{p.updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_rule SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_rule SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_rule WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_rule WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_code=#{ruleCode} AND id != #{excludeId}
SELECT project_id FROM dm_rule WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
